purpose_context: A prior investigation squad found that CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, and README.md describe repository structure that no longer exists (committed .cursor//.claude/, a src/framework + tests/framework|orchestration|integration|unit tree, a local pack/tools/fallback/ toolguide, several dangling doc paths), and that gemini-bot-georgia's agent profile still targets a retired local gemini-agents/ directory instead of the new dedicated regnology-ps-chatbots repository. This mission reconciles the docs with reality and repoints Georgia, and adds a lightweight lint script so doc-path drift is caught going forward.
purpose_tldr: Fix structural-documentation drift in CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/README.md and repoint Georgia's chatbot profile to the new regnology-ps-chatbots repo
